steps.subject: The right terminal for your business, {{firstName}}
steps.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Based on your business type and volume, we recommend the {{recommendedTerminal}}.

Here's why it's a great fit:

  • Optimized for {{industry}} businesses
  • Supports tap, chip, swipe, and contactless payments

Equipment options and any terms depend on your business and are confirmed during your review. Reply to this email and we'll walk through what fits.

— Liberty Bancard

Eligibility, underwriting, card brand rules, and applicable laws apply.

steps.subject: Know another business owner who could save on processing?
steps.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

We appreciate your business. If you know any other merchants who might benefit from a free rate review, we'd love an introduction. As a thank-you, we offer a referral credit for every merchant who signs on through your recommendation.

If someone comes to mind, just reply to this email with their name and we'll take it from there.

— Liberty Bancard

Referral program terms and conditions apply.
